: a meta policy
only governs what the parser has not reached yet.
This is a meta tag rather than a response header because the runtime has
no CSP field in app.toml and emits one only on its own admin pages. A
header would be better (meta ignores frame-ancestors and report-uri);
framing is already covered by X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN.
`script-src` is the part that earns its keep: with no 'unsafe-inline'
there, a `javascript:` href does not execute, which is the second layer
under safeHref()/check_url(). Do not add 'unsafe-inline' to script-src.
Why each exception exists, so nobody widens these by guesswork:
- 'wasm-unsafe-eval' is REQUIRED, not optional: the Crux core ships as a
WebAssembly module and script-src governs wasm compilation. Without it
WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming throws and the page renders blank —
a total outage, not a degraded one. It permits wasm only; it does not
re-enable eval() or inline script.
- ensemble.everything.e6software.com serves the feedback toolbar and
receives its submissions. It is injected for [authz] admins only.
- style-src 'unsafe-inline': the shell sets ~28 React style attributes
and the toolbar builds its own elements. Styles cannot script.
- img-src data: blob:: the toolbar renders inline icons and canvas
screenshots. Signed asset images are same-origin under /_everything/.
- static.cloudflareinsights.com / cloudflareinsights.com: the site is
behind Cloudflare, which injects its Web Analytics beacon into every
page. The script loads from the first host and reports to the second;
without both, every page logged a CSP error and analytics recorded
nothing (September 2026). -->
